name: Vinegar: Brand & Product Ownership Checker
description: Reveals brand ownership while you shop online.

_permission_justifications.tabs: Open sign-in, contribute, report, billing, and account pages when the user clicks popup or in-page links
_permission_justifications.storage: Store the auth token, UI preferences, avoid-list sync state, and cached subscription tier
_permission_justifications.alarms: Run periodic background syncs for the avoid list (every 1 min) and premium status (every 2 min)

_host_permission_justifications.https://getvinegar.com/*: Vinegar API for lookups, auth, and account pages
